rainfall continues.

* WHERE...York County in east central Nebraska...
Fillmore County in south central Nebraska...
Southeastern Hamilton County in south central Nebraska...

* WHEN...Until 200 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Expect many
areas of slow moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 649 PM CDT, trained weather spotters reported flooding in the
warned area. Flooding is already occurring. Between 2 and 5
inches of rain have fallen.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
West Fork of the Big Blue River, Beaver Creek, Lincoln Creek,
School Creek, Turkey Creek, Little Sandy Creek, and Dry Sandy
Creek. Flooding impacts will continue, but no appreciable
additional rainfall is expected. A river gauge near Grafton
continues to report flooding along the West Fork Big Blue River
from Grafton to McCool Junction.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
properties.area: Fillmore, NE; Hamilton, NE; York, NE

properties.title: Flood Warning issued June 6 at 6:01PM CDT until June 7 at 9:00AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall will
continue through tonight. This includes portions of Cedar Creek,
English Creek and White Breast Creek.

* WHERE...A portion of south central Iowa, including the following
county, Marion.

* WHEN...Until 900 AM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Low-water crossings are inundated with water and may not
be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 601 PM CDT, The Marion County Emergency Management has
reported flooding in the warned area. This includes numerous
road closures as area streams continue to rise in some areas
from last nights heavy rainfall. Flooding is already
occurring.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Melcher-Dallas, Bussey, Hamilton and Marysville.
properties.instruction:
Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued June 6 at 12:06PM PDT by NWS Spokane WA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Washington...

Stehekin River at Stehekin affecting Chelan County.

For the Stehekin River...including Stehekin...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and forecast to continue.

* WHERE...Stehekin River at Stehekin.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 20.5 feet, water inundates some properties and
overtops the temporary corduroy bridge. Company Creek Road
inundated at northern end. Battalion Creek culverts are beginning
to be overtopped. Water begins damaging Wood Road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:30 AM PDT Saturday the stage was 20.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 19.5 feet.
- Forecast...Stehekin River will fall below flood stage late
tonight, dropping to 20.2 feet by Monday afternoon. Through
the rest of the week it will periodically drop to Action
Stage before rising back into Minor Flood Stage.
- Flood stage is 20.5 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
This warning will be in effect until the river falls below its flood
stage.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive
cars through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday afternoon at noon PDT.
